rules.title: Business-relevant state changes are auditable
rules.description: Every meaningful change to business state is recorded. Derived, transient, or serialized metadata may be excluded where it can be safely reconstructed and has no compliance, security, or business-history value.
rules.rationale: A system whose state changes cannot be reconstructed cannot be audited, debugged, or trusted with compliance obligations.
rules.remediation: Record business mutations through an audit path that captures what changed.
rules.$assuranceNote: The evaluator observes whether audit infrastructure exists. It does not observe whether mutations use it. A pass is partial evidence and MUST NOT be reported as 'all business mutations are audited' (Standard 24 R2).

rules.title: Mutations carry actor context
rules.description: Every mutation records whether it came from a user, API client, scheduled job, or a named agent, plus correlation or request identifiers.
rules.rationale: An audit trail that cannot say who caused a change answers the least useful half of the question.
rules.remediation: Attach actor and correlation identifiers to every audited mutation.
rules.$assuranceNote: No analyzer exists. Reported as not-evaluated rather than passing (Standard 24 R4).
